text:
Priya Sharma: heads up — we spun up a dark-launch for the new routing-intent telemetry (X-Route-Intent) on prod canary yesterday, not exposing to customers yet
Maya Chen: nice. did we wire that into the console metrics pipeline or just into raw logs?
Priya Sharma: raw logs -> kafka topic. plan is to add a console preview tile next week that reads the dark stream (internal only)
James O'Neill: question — how are we attributing quota? if route-intent changes routing decisions we might accidentally double-charge tenants for fallback routes
Leo Park: good call. current plan: keep billing tied to execution model used (final model id), not route-intent header. telemetry will have a separate attribution column for analytics only
Priya Sharma: exactly. billing unaffected during dark launch. we want metrics to validate routing heuristics & fallback frequency before any quota policy change
Alex Morgan: SDK impact? Python/TS/Go need to surface the header in client metadata so apps can opt-in to send intent for better routing accuracy
Maya Chen: SDK teams requested a safe opt-in API (no breaking defaults). propose: expose client.route_intent = "string" or helper send_route_intent() that adds header when set
James O'Neill: +1 for opt-in. avoid default behavior that could leak internal signals. also need a fallback so older SDKs don't fail when gateway sees the header
Priya Sharma: gateway will ignore unknown headers. but we need SDKs to sign the header for internal verification (HMAC) — prevents customer spoofing of intents
Leo Park: signing is fine. what about telemetry sampling? we don't want to explode cardinality in observability
Alex Morgan: plan: sample 5% of requests for full intent payloads, stash stats (counts/frequency) for all requests. then adaptive increase if signal is noisy
Maya Chen: console tile should show sampled vs aggregated numbers and a preview of most common intents. internal-only toggle: "show dark intents"
James O'Neill: rollout UX nuance: make it explicit in release notes & console that these metrics are internal and won't affect quotas. users might panic if they see new fields suddenly
Priya Sharma: agreed — internal banner + tooltip. also coordinate with SSO/docs so support doesn't get deluged
Leo Park: SDK break window? timeline? python/ts minor releases next Tue/Wed, go later that week. we'll keep semver minor (no breaking) because default behavior remains off
Alex Morgan: sample header usage in Python SDK: ```python
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., route_intent="recommendation-v2-user-attrs")
resp = client.generate(prompt)
```
Maya Chen: include helper method too: ```python
with client.with_route_intent("rec-v2"):
    client.generate(...)
```
James O'Neill: add doc blurb about HMAC signing and how keys rotate (short key TTL)
Priya Sharma: deploy-bot: canary rollout health looks green since 04:30 UTC, error rate unchanged
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary: routing-intent-dark v0.1 -> 6 hosts (ok)
Maya Chen: next steps: SDK PRs + internal console tile prototype by EOD Thursday, opt-in release notes, and a small support playbook
Priya Sharma: I'll schedule a 30m sync Friday to sign off on telemetry fields and sampling knobs
James O'Neill: great. tagging @console-bot for the tile work so we can test internal queries
console-bot: noted — will add a draft tile flagged internal/dark and link to the sample query
Leo Park: minor ask — add a dashboard alert if fallback rate > 5% for any tenant for 10m. early warning for routing regressions
Priya Sharma: added to the list. thanks everyone :)
Maya Chen: :thumbsup:
